acceptance_criterion: The request captures event name, purpose, description, proposed date, start and end time, expected attendance, venue requirements, accessibility needs, equipment requirements, and whether registration is required
test_name: shows the full submitted content, including requirements

acceptance_criterion: On a successful submission the request is stored with status Submitted, and the submitting organiser, submission timestamp, and a unique event reference are recorded
test_name: stores the request as Submitted with a reference and a submission time

acceptance_criterion: The submitting organiser is recorded as the owner of the event
test_name: records the submitting organiser as the owner of the event

acceptance_criterion: The submitted request appears in the Event Coordinator review queue
test_name: shows a submitted request with the details a coordinator triages on

acceptance_criterion: On submission the assigned coordinator (E1) is notified that a new event request is awaiting review
test_name: raises the notification that a new request awaits review, in the same transaction

acceptance_criterion: If submission fails validation, no event record is created and no submission timestamp is recorded
test_name: creates no event record at all when validation fails (B1, B2)

acceptance_criterion: The request captures venue requirements and equipment requirements
test_name: stores the venue and equipment requirements it captures (B1)

acceptance_criterion: The request form captures venue requirements and equipment requirements
test_name: sends venue requirements as a layout, a list of facilities and notes
